WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
account_with_region AS (
  SELECT a.account_id, aa.avg_amount, d.A3 as region
  FROM account_avg aa
  JOIN account a ON aa.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
),
region_avg AS (
  SELECT region, AVG(avg_amount) as region_figure
  FROM account_with_region
  GROUP BY region
),
all_region_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(region_figure) as global_avg
  FROM region_avg
)
SELECT 
  r.region,
  r.region_figure,
  r.region_figure - ara.global_avg as exceeds_avg,
  r.region_figure / ara.global_avg as ratio
FROM region_avg r
CROSS JOIN all_region_avg ara
WHERE r.region_figure > ara.global_avg
ORDER BY r.region_figure DESC
